title: eludite.editor.accept_completion input
description: Commit an item of the open completion list (Tab, or Enter on a selected item): applies the item's text edit, or inserts its text over the word typed so far. Snippet placeholders are inserted as plain text.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

label.description: Commit the matching item with this label instead of the selected one.
